confirmed: The complete markdown, including references and appendices, was read. The local PDF has 21 pages and identifies arXiv:2601.18193v1, 26 Jan 2026; title, authors and DOI 10.1145/3772318.3791675 match the form (p. 1).

No randomized allocation of people or condition order is stated. The within-person comparison uses Latin-square counterbalancing; has_randomized_people_study = false denotes no documented randomized people study, with assignment status still not_stated (p. 11, Section 6.3; p. 12, Figure 7).

The user study recruited and analyzed 12 unique people, each in both conditions, rather than 24 independent people; no exclusions or randomized sample count are stated (pp. 11-12, Sections 6.2-6.5; p. 14, Figure 10).
Participants were university students: 10 design majors and 2 art majors, 11 female and 1 male, age M = 21.83, SD = 2.03 (p. 11, Section 6.2; p. 12, Table 4).

Both arms provided generative AI. The baseline used the same painting dataset without displayed annotations, plus ChatGPT and Midjourney on their original platforms; ai_design is appropriate (p. 11, Section 6.1).

The scored output was the verbally described design idea with visual references. Two external design raters scored clarity and appeal on a 7-point scale, and their post-discussion scores were averaged; this supports an output-scored quality/usefulness outcome (p. 12, Section 6.4).

S1-O1: InkIdeator 5.83 (SD 1.09) versus Baseline 5.50 (SD 1.46), paired-sample t-test p = 0.254, within-person N = 12. All numbers in its reported string match (p. 12, Section 6.5; p. 13, Section 7.1; p. 14, Figure 10).
S1-O2, Q4 Exploration: InkIdeator 5.75 (SD 0.75) versus Baseline 4.92 (SD 0.79); Wilcoxon Z = -2.887, p = 0.004. All numbers match (p. 14, Figure 10; p. 15, Section 7.1).
S1-O3, Q3 Expressiveness: InkIdeator 4.92 (SD 1.24) versus Baseline 3.92 (SD 1.08); Wilcoxon Z = -2.360, p = 0.018. All numbers match (p. 14, Figure 10; p. 15, Section 7.1).

Exploration and expressiveness are self-reported creativity-support items, correctly marked scored_on_output = false and question = none; they are not objective creativity or across-person diversity scores (p. 12, Section 6.4; p. 14, Figure 10).

Core exclusion remains correct because only 12 people were analyzed, below the codebook threshold of 50. Keep random assignment unclear and context_class = none; the available evidence does not establish an eligible observational, AI-versus-human, or synthesis context study (pp. 11-12, Sections 6.1-6.5; p. 10, Table 3; pp. 15-16, Section 8).

Separate supplementary materials are mentioned for the annotated design space and evaluation prompts/outputs. Appendix B is included in the PDF and describes the model-output evaluation; it is distinct from those external supplementary materials (p. 3, footnote 1; p. 10, Section 5.2; p. 20, Appendix B).
This is a system-development paper with empirical evaluations, not a synthesis; the empty synthesis fields are appropriate (p. 3, contributions; p. 18, Section 10).
The document discloses academic affiliations and public/academic funding, with no company involvement stated (p. 1, affiliations; p. 18, Section 11).
summary: The 12-person analysis sample and all three reported outcome statistics match the PDF, but randomized assignment is not documented and lab_rct is unsupported. Corrections also identify 24 scored ideas, repair locators and missing study, method and code details, and qualify the nonsignificant finding; exclusion from the core dataset remains appropriate.
